$comment: One entry of nexthint.json: a rule that names the likely next tools in one state of the document (agentlink/nexthint.py).

additionalProperties.description: The value the fact must have, or a list of values of which it must have one.

unless.description: Facts of which none may hold.

additionalProperties.description: The value the fact must have, or a list of values of which it must have one.

suggest.description: The tools, likeliest first (at most four are read). A tool with arguments is also an option: a ready call with its open inputs (ask).

why.description: Not read: the why that is said is the facts the rule fits by (nexthint.fact_words; owner, 27 Nov: facts only). Kept so an add-on's older rules still load.

arguments.description: Makes the tool an option (agentlink/options.py): the arguments the state settles. A value that starts with "=" is an expression of the hub's checked language (agentlink/expr.py), read with facts (the names facts() gives: facts.bodyName, facts.sketchName, facts.editSketch, facts.pickedEdges ...); a value that comes out None is left out. Any other value is used as it is. {} for a call with no arguments.

ask.description: The open inputs the person or the agent gives with pick, in order.

unit.description: A number in this unit; plain text "4mm", "1 in", "90deg" is read in it.

sample.description: A value used only to check the option's arguments before it is shown, never in the call. Without one, a refusal that names this argument does not drop the option.

or.description: Plain words that stand for this input: { word: { arguments } } ("through_all": { "extent": "through_all" }).

choices.description: Live choices for an argument (the real bodies, sketches, faces): an expression as in arguments that gives a list, or a list. Shown only when there is more than one.
